create_sam3_interactive_image_predictor: create a SAM3InteractiveImagePredictor instance with a Sam3TrackerBase model and mask processing parameters
set_image_predictor: set an image on the SAM3InteractiveImagePredictor to compute embeddings for mask prediction
predict_sam3_masks: predict segmentation masks from point, box, or mask prompts using the SAM3InteractiveImagePredictor
predict_batch_sam3_masks: predict segmentation masks for a batch of images using batched point, box, and mask prompts
get_image_embedding: retrieve the computed image embedding tensor from the SAM3InteractiveImagePredictor
